name: Thomas Chacra
subtitle: Junior Application Support Agent, Netcompany
title: Bioengineer | Data validation, workflow support & clear documentation
summary: Bioengineer who has spent the last years making messy data usable and explaining technical problems to people who have no time for jargon. I validate data, document rules and procedures, and digitise workflows that were previously manual. I want to do that for systems that serve environmental regulation.

experience.title: Sustainability Adviser
experience.context: Compostable packaging and sustainable supply chains
bullets: Maintained the documentation and assumptions behind a product carbon model to ISO 14067, so that every figure could be traced back to its source.
Structured supplier and freight records from several sources into one consistent dataset for reporting.

experience.title: ESG & Sustainability Analyst
bullets: Controlled the quality and consistency of client datasets, documenting the validation rules applied and logging every input that failed them.
Digitised a client audit trail with Power Automate, filing documents into the correct folders and removing a manual workflow.
Automated an ESG certification analysis with Power Query and Excel macros, cutting processing time by 70 percent, and built the Power BI reports that consultants used with clients.

experience.title: AI Quality Assurance Assistant
bullets: Evaluated system outputs against documented quality rules, investigated inconsistencies, and logged defects in a shared tracker with reproducible descriptions.
Performed data validation and consistency checks across annotated datasets, and contributed to the working notes the project team reused.

experience.title: Research and Development Scientist
bullets: Built automated reporting and monitoring tools, and translated their output into plain-language guidance for engineers and agronomists.

experience.title: Energy and Environmental Consultant
bullets: Advised clients on environmental and regulatory constraints for energy systems, answering technical questions and preparing the material presented to them.

sidebar.heading: Key skills
paras:
Data: validation, consistency checks, quality rules, documentation of procedures and FAQs.
Systems: Power Query, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python.
Service: explaining technical issues to non-specialist users, writing reproduction notes.

sidebar.heading: Regulation
paras: EU environmental reporting context: CSRD, ESRS, GHG Protocol, waste and supplier data. Comfortable reading regulatory text and turning it into a data check.
